svg.title: The contract with a real Paperless-ngx
svg.desc: Every Monday, when started by hand, and in a pull request that changes the app or the mock, the job paperless runs paperless-contract.sh for Paperless-ngx 2 and 3. It starts that Paperless with Redis, Nextcloud with the app and the mock, and assert_contract.py gives Paperless three synthetic text files. Then it checks, with the version of the API and the fields that the app asks for, the fields, dates, excerpts, pages and errors, the newest documents, the names of correspondents, types and tags and what /api/ui_settings/ says an account may do directly, and the test of the connection, the warnings about the token and the results with their names through Nextcloud. Then it sends the requests of the app to this Paperless and to the mock, whose answers have to have the same form. The summary of the job shows the versions, every check and every difference of the mock. A broken contract fails the required check, so the pull request can't merge; a failed weekly run opens or updates the issue Paperless-ngx breaks the app, and a run that passes closes it.
